page.layout: Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Two coin medallions (engravings) side by side, left and right, with their legends in the circles. Below them one column of running text, full width. Gathering signature at lower right, below the text. No margin notes.

page.notes: The two medallions are engraved portraits; their legends are transcribed above as lines. Doubtful: the mark before "Alexandrum" in the first paragraph (shown as a curved stroke) is marked [?]. The first words of both paragraphs are set in spaced capitals; the first was set in italic-like spacing and is given in italics as headword. The line "Quod tibi fieri non vis" is underlined in print; underline not reproduced.
